 then
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :sunit_id2 := null;
 end if;
 temp_unit_id := nvl(:sunit_id2,nvl(:sunit_id,:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id));
 savepoint all_clear;
 :system.message_level := 5;

 /*-- The batch ID is generated here but not assigned to the screen column batch_id
 of block ctrl_blk_2. Only after all the updations are over, the batch ID 
 value is displayed on the screen. The reason for this is - if any updation fails
 and the data is rolled back, the batch_id will not display the generated ID.--*/

 if :ctrl_blk_2.batch_id = 'NEW' then
 gen_batch_id (temp_batch_id);
 insert_batch (temp_batch_id) ;
 else
 temp_batch_id := :ctrl_blk_2.batch_id ;
 end if ;

 update_units (temp_unit_id,temp_batch_id) ;
 --synchronize; --muk
 update_temp_tubes(temp_unit_id) ;

 /*-- Update UTRS only if tests have not been already scheduled ---*/
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from utrs
 where unit_id = temp_unit_id
 and coll_date = :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and rownum = 1 ;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 update_utrs(temp_unit_id) ;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end ;

 :ctrl_blk_2.batch_id := temp_batch_id ;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 clear_globals;
 if :s_format in ('P*','P1','P2')
 then
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 check_package_Failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GEN_BATCH_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure gen_batch_id(temp_batch_id out varchar) is
begin
 select to_char(sysdate, 'mmddyy') || '-CB' || LPAD(to_char(nvl(batch_seq, 1000) + 1), 4, '0')
 into temp_batch_id
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 for update of batch_seq;
 begin
 update chapters
 set batch_seq = nvl(batch_seq, 1000) + 1
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_BATCH
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure insert_batch (temp_batch_id in varchar) is
dummy_x VARCHAR2(1);
begin
 select distinct 'x' into dummy_x
 from batch_inputs where
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 contract_id = :ctrl_blk_2.contract_id and
 batch_id = :ctrl_blk_2.batch_id;
 exception when no_data_found
 then
 begin
 insert into batch_inputs
 (batch_id,
 chapter_id,
 contract_id,
 received_date,
 min_temp,
 max_temp,
 checkin_user_id,
 insert_dats)
 values
 (temp_batch_id,
 :global.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.contract_id,
 trunc(sysdate),
 0,
 0,
 decode(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,4),'OPS$',substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5,6),LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid),
 sysdate);
 exception when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_UNITS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE update_units (temp_unit_id in varchar,temp_batch_id in varchar)IS
 temp_chk_digit varchar2(2) := chk_digit_query(temp_unit_id,null,null); 
BEGIN
 if :GLOBAL.unit_trns_exists = 'Y' 
 then
 begin
 update units
 set batch_id = temp_batch_id ,
 red_tube_flag = decode(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,null,red_tube_flag,'Y'),
 purple_tube_flag = decode(:sunit_id,null,purple_tube_flag,'Y'),
 serum_plasma_ind = decode(:sunit_id2,null,serum_plasma_ind,'Y'),
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = temp_unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('7');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :GLOBAL.unit_trns_exists = 'N' 
 then
 begin

 end;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_UTRS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE update_utrs (temp_unit_id in varchar) IS
 temp_test_seq_no number;
 temp_decision_code varchar(1) ;
 cursor c2 is
 select test_id
 from contract_tests
 where contract_id = 'INTERNAL'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 cursor c1 is
 select test_id, test_seq_no,
 test_state, test_mode,
 result_status_1, result_status_2,
 tb_id, test_chapter_id, tb_seq_no,
 well_number, absorbance, ratio, result_dats,
 result_user_id, testing_lab_code, cancel_flag
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = temp_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 tb_id is not null and
 result_status_1 is not null and
 result_status_2 is null and
 cancel_flag is null
 order by test_id, test_seq_no;
 cursor c3 is
 select test_id, test_seq_no, insert_Dats,
 insert_user_id, program_id
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = temp_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 tb_id is null
 order by test_id, test_seq_no;
begin
 temp_decision_code := 'N' ;
 if :global.cue_scan_flag = 'Y' then
 begin
 select donor_decision_code into temp_decision_code
 from units
 where unit_id = temp_unit_id ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if ;
 -- The following block moves transactions from utb to utrs.
 -- It is only done for non-therapeutic donations.
 -- The sequence of utr activity is as follows:
 -- 1. Insert transcations in utr from profile tests
 -- 2. Insert transcations in utr from transactions in utb
 -- which were scheduled from the core routine. and the
 -- test results have still not come. These can be
 -- identified by tb_id being null.
 -- 3. Update results from utb to utrs as present.
 -- 4. Transfer all reconciled tests from UTB to UTR(as left in UTB)
 --
 -- DO NOT CHANGE THIS SEQUENCE WHATEVER HAPPENS !!
 --
 -- Step .1.
 --
 if nvl(temp_decision_code,'*') != 'T'
 then
 begin
 for c2_rec in c2
 loop
 begin
 insert into utrs
 (unit_id,coll_date,chapter_id,test_seq_no,test_id,
 insert_dats,insert_user_id,program_id)
 select temp_unit_id, :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 nvl(max(test_seq_no),0)+1, c2_rec.test_id,
 sysdate, :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name
 from utrs
 where unit_id = temp_unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and test_id = c2_rec.test_id;
 --
 -- check for cancel_flag being null has been
 -- intentionally removed
 --
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting into utrs - 1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end loop;
 end;
 --
 -- Step .2.
 --
 begin
 for c3_rec in c3
 loop
 begin
 insert into utrs
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id,
 test_seq_no, test_id, insert_dats, insert_user_id,
 program_id)
 select temp_unit_id , :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 nvl(max(test_seq_no),0)+1, c3_rec.test_id,
 c3_rec.insert_dats, c3_rec.insert_user_id,
 c3_rec.program_id
 from utrs
 where unit_id = temp_unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = c3_rec.test_id;
 --
 -- check for cancel_flag being null has been
 -- intentionally removed
 --
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in inserting into utrs from utb');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 begin
 delete from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = temp_unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = c3_rec.test_id and
 test_seq_no = c3_rec.test_seq_no;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in deleting from utb - 1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 end loop;
 end;
 --
 -- Step .3.
 --
 begin
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 begin
 select min(test_seq_no)
 into temp_test_seq_no
 from utrs
 where unit_id = temp_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = c1_rec.test_id and
 result_status_1 is null and
 cancel_flag is null;
 if nvl(temp_test_seq_no,0) >= 1
 then
 begin
 update utrs
 set test_state = c1_rec.test_state,
 test_mode = c1_rec.test_mode,
 result_status_1 =
 c1_rec.result_status_1,
 result_status_2 =
 c1_rec.result_status_2,
 tb_id = c1_rec.tb_id,
 test_chapter_id =
 c1_rec.test_chapter_id,
 tb_seq_no = c1_rec.tb_seq_no,
 well_number = c1_rec.well_number,
 absorbance = c1_rec.absorbance,
 ratio = c1_rec.ratio,
 result_dats = c1_rec.result_dats,
 result_user_id = c1_rec.result_user_id,
 testing_lab_code =
 c1_rec.testing_lab_code
 where unit_id = temp_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = c1_rec.test_id and
 test_seq_no = temp_test_seq_no and
 cancel_flag is null;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating utr');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 insert into utrs
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, test_id,
 test_seq_no, test_state, test_mode,
 result_status_1, result_status_2, tb_id,
 test_chapter_id, tb_seq_no, well_number,
 absorbance, ratio, result_dats,
 result_user_id, testing_lab_code,
 insert_dats, insert_user_id, cancel_flag,
 program_id)
 select unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id,
 test_id, nvl(max(test_seq_no),0)+1,
 c1_rec.test_state, c1_rec.test_mode,
 c1_rec.result_status_1,
 c1_rec.result_status_2, c1_rec.tb_id,
 c1_rec.test_chapter_id,
 c1_rec.tb_seq_no, c1_rec.well_number,
 c1_rec.absorbance, c1_rec.ratio,
 c1_rec.result_dats,
 c1_rec.result_user_id,
 c1_rec.testing_lab_code,
 sysdate, :banner.user_id,
 c1_rec.cancel_flag, :banner.prog_name
 from utrs
 where unit_id = temp_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) =
 trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = c1_rec.test_id
 group by unit_id, coll_date,
 chapter_id, test_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in transferring from UTB to UTR');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 begin
 delete from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = temp_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = c1_rec.test_id and
 test_seq_no = c1_rec.test_seq_no;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in deleting from utb - 2');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end;
 end loop;
 end;
 end if;

END;
